overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Your Law 25, PIPEDA and PHIPA program at a glance.
overview.exposurePlaceholder: The two-axis exposure map arrives in a later phase. It plots physical data residency against operator jurisdiction so the CLOUD Act question becomes answerable.

reasons.canadian_controlled: Data in Canada with a Canadian-controlled operator.
reasons.cloud_act_mismatch: Hosted in Canada but operated by a US-parent entity — reachable under the US CLOUD Act. A transfer assessment is required.
reasons.foreign_operator_mismatch: Hosted in Canada but operated by a foreign-controlled entity. Assessment required.
reasons.data_abroad_canadian_operator: Data is hosted outside Canada. The transfer must be assessed.
reasons.foreign_residency_and_operator: Data hosted outside Canada with a foreign operator.

residency.title: Data residency map
residency.subtitle: Physical data residency versus operator jurisdiction — the CLOUD Act question, made answerable.
residency.flowsSubtitle: Each link from a data category to a vendor, with its computed exposure.
residency.crossBorderSubtitle: Flows requiring a transfer assessment under Law 25 art. 17.
residency.noVendors: Add vendors and data assets first to model data flows.
residency.demoNotice: Demo mode — connect Supabase to add or remove data flows.
residency.exportHint: This map is the documented deliverable to the client; PDF export arrives in a later phase.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.subtitle: Service providers and operators, with hosting region and operator jurisdiction.
vendors.demoNotice: Demo mode — connect Supabase to add, edit, or delete vendors.
vendors.jurisdictionHint: Derived from the operator's corporate parent, not where data is hosted.
vendors.cloudActHint: A US-parent operator is reachable under the US CLOUD Act even when it hosts in Canada.

inventory.title: Data inventory
inventory.subtitle: Categories of personal information your organization holds.
inventory.demoNotice: Demo mode — connect Supabase to add, edit, or delete data assets.

findings.title: Risk register
findings.subtitle: Indicative findings from the assessment. Each is a signal until a credentialed practitioner confirms it.
findings.demoNotice: Demo mode — findings are evaluated live and shown as indicative. Connect Supabase to persist and promote them.
findings.empty: No findings yet. Run an assessment to evaluate your program.

why.PRIVACY_OFFICER_NAMED: No named, recorded privacy officer was found. Law 25 requires a designated person accountable for protecting personal information.
why.VENDOR_DUE_DILIGENCE: This vendor has no documented due-diligence assessment on file.
why.CROSS_BORDER_TRANSFER: This flow carries cross-border exposure that has not been assessed for adequacy.
why.BREACH_RESPONSE: No documented breach-response process was found.
why.SAFEGUARDS: Security safeguards have not been documented.

findings.reviewNote: This finding is a signal, not a verdict. It becomes authoritative only when a credentialed practitioner promotes it (next phase).
findings.addOfficerHint: Recording an accountability contact resolves the privacy officer finding on the next assessment.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.subtitle: AI-drafted, defensible artifacts generated from your engagement data. Every draft needs credentialed review before it is authoritative.
evidence.demoNotice: Demo mode — connect Supabase and the Anthropic API to generate artifact drafts.
evidence.aiNoticeShort: Generated by Claude from your engagement data; review required.
evidence.aiNotice: This draft was generated by Claude from your engagement data. It is not authoritative and must be reviewed by a credentialed practitioner. It is documentation and recommendations only — not legal advice.

descriptions.privacy_impact_assessment: Évaluation des facteurs relatifs à la vie privée (EFVP) covering the processing, risks, and mitigations.
descriptions.data_inventory: A record of the personal information your organization holds.
descriptions.vendor_due_diligence: A due-diligence file across your vendors and operators.
descriptions.foreign_transfer_adequacy: A transfer adequacy assessment for each flagged cross-border flow (Law 25 art. 17).
descriptions.breach_response_runbook: An incident response runbook aligned to Law 25 art. 3.5.
descriptions.privacy_officer_record: An accountability record for the designated privacy officer (Law 25 art. 3.1–3.3).

audit.title: Audit prep
audit.subtitle: Credentialed reviewers, immutable sign-offs, and the tamper-evident log.
audit.reviewersSubtitle: Credentialed practitioners who can promote findings and approve artifacts.
audit.chainValid: Audit log verified — {count} entries, chain intact.
audit.chainInvalid: Chain integrity check FAILED at entry #{seq}.
audit.chainEmpty: No audit entries yet. Promotions and approvals will appear here.
audit.demoNotice: Demo mode — connect Supabase to manage reviewers and record sign-offs.

promote.needsReviewer: Add a credentialed reviewer in Audit prep before promoting.
promote.confirmedNote: Confirmed by a credentialed practitioner. Recorded in the append-only audit log.
promote.approvedNote: Approved by a credentialed practitioner. Recorded in the append-only audit log.
